in_marathi.name: Avijith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Newborn, Free from birth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avijith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avijith is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'avij' meaning new and 'jith' meaning born. This name signifies a newborn who is free from the cycle of birth and death.
